Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/confirmation-visible/ledger/solution.py`.

It selects, per exact key, the event with the greatest revision (last event wins on ties), emits winning puts as `{key, revision, value}`, emits winning deletes as `{key, revision}` only when `config["include_deleted"]` is true, sorts both lists by key using normal Python string ordering, preserves empty keys and JSON values, and does not mutate the inputs.
